correctness.rationale: The rational expansion of P(a+9t) gives six regular branches surjecting onto 3Z_3 and three quadratic-critical branches. Hensel and the p-adic square-image lemma give exact critical images; reflection identifies two, and their critical values are distinct modulo 9. Counting nonzero squares by even 3-adic valuation gives the all-k count and 5/12 Haar density. All nine rational coefficient identities were checked; independent direct exhaustive finite-modulus tests for exponents 1..9 agree with both the predicted sets and cardinalities. The proof covers arbitrary exponent and distinguishes finite verification from proof.

value.rationale: Index six is the first index after the known universal sequence 1..5 that fails at an admissible prime, making the size and structure of its 3-adic image a naturally motivated invariant. The exact 5/12 density and the three-component quadratic-ramification structure explain infinitely many missing residue classes and determine every finite precision, substantially beyond the elementary mod-three obstruction.
